C_GLOBAL_STANDARD.statement: The released theorem and staged update establish the conventional full existential entropy counterexample on a compact smooth boundaryless manifold.

C_GLOBAL_BRIDGES.statement: The released manifold, C1, entropy, homology, spectral radius, and noninvertibility have their standard meanings, and its raw witness is an admissible staged specialization.

C_RELEASE_PRIMARY.statement: The immutable published acceptance record is bound to the exact released global theorem at OpenAI fd4aeeb2ee4fc729c18d98444fed42fd0529eeeb under Lean 4.34.1.

C_GOG_PRIOR.statement: Gogolev's October 11 primary note already states the every-finite-regularity seven-dimensional counterexamples; these are not novel campaign conclusions.

C_MAIN.statement: The constructed C1 map has zero topological entropy and eigenvalue 2 on second real homology.

C_REGULARITY.statement: Uniform convergence of the prediction-input first derivatives gives a global C1 self-map.

C_ATTRACTION.statement: Every orbit approaches the union of the zero and infinity invariant sets.

C_BOUNDED_CLOCK.statement: A bounded lifted clock converges to 50 modulo 100 and the main coordinate tends to zero.

C_SUCCESSIVE_PASSAGES.statement: Escape growth persists across later complete passages and eventually all registers reset permanently to zero.

C_PASSAGE_CORE.statement: Every complete passage of the simultaneous nonlinear recurrence, with arbitrary finite duration, has clock prediction agreement, single-hit readouts, pre-readout linearity, aligned additions, and compulsory escape.

C_PREPARATION.statement: Reset precedes nonempty bounded preparation; preparation radii exceed one half and a readout plateau is crossed.

C_PHASE_ESCAPE.statement: All readout contributions align with the main square, preserve nonvanishing and phase doubling, and force a radius greater than one within the passage.

C_ZERO_ENTROPY.statement: The constructed map has zero topological entropy.

C_ENTROPY_LOCALIZATION.statement: Pointwise attraction to a compact forward-invariant zero-entropy set implies zero entropy.

C_REGISTER_ENTROPY.statement: The radial nondecreasing register map, after its first image enters the invariant disk, has zero entropy in every finite product.

C_HOMOLOGY.statement: The bounded perturbation homotopy yields a surjective intertwiner and eigenvalue 2 on second real homology.
